summary.allegation: The cardholder says they ordered clothing on 22 March 2025 and never received the package, and that two contacts with the merchant did not resolve it, so the issuer raised a 13.1 non receipt chargeback for GBP 189.99.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show proof of delivery to the cardholder's address on or before the chargeback date, with carrier name, tracking number and confirmation of delivery.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB shows the item posted 23 March 2025 and delivered and signed for at SW4 7QR on 24 March 2025, with the recipient named as M. Whitford at 22 Cavendish Court.

citations.quote: Proof of Delivery: Signature on file. This item was delivered to the address shown and signed for at 11:47 on 24 March 2025.
Dispatched 23 March 2025 via Royal Mail Tracked 24

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: The transaction is for physical merchandise, a Heritage Wool Overcoat shipped by Royal Mail, so the services evidence requirement does not apply.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: Delivery is recorded on 24 March 2025 at 11:47, two days after the 22 March 2025 purchase and well before the 18 April 2025 chargeback.

citations.quote: Delivered 24 March 2025, 11:47 — signed for at SW4 7QR

requirements.title: Delivery address matches
requirements.text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.finding: The delivery address 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR matches the billing and shipping postcode on the transaction record, and AVS returned Y with CVV M and a 3DS authenticated result.

citations.quote:
Billing address: 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR
Shipping address: 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

justification: Carrier proof of delivery with signature to the cardholder's own address, supported by full AVS, CVV and 3DS matches, meets every applicable 13.1 requirement.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the goods ordered on 22 March 2025 for GBP 189.99 were never received.
Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB for order NT-44912 shows the parcel posted 23 March 2025 and delivered and signed for by WHITFORD at 11:47 on 24 March 2025.
The delivery address, 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR, matches the billing and shipping postcode captured at authorisation.
The transaction carried AVS Y, CVV M and a successful 3DS authentication from a UK IP, consistent with the genuine cardholder placing the order.
Delivery on 24 March 2025 preceded the 18 April 2025 chargeback, so the non receipt claim is rebutted and the case should be represented in full.
